subject: Audit logs & data access evidence - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Audit logs & data access evidence - next steps

Hi Aisha - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Recap: You asked for examples of audit-log exports showing "who accessed what/when" for user-facing requests, plus details on export formats and retention.
- What we'll provide: 1) a schema/spec of our audit-log fields, 2) a sample export (CSV) with redacted PII, 3) notes on retention and IAM controls, and 4) details on how to run an ad-hoc export for your auditors.

Next steps: 
1) We will share the audit log spec + a redacted sample CSV by end of day tomorrow (Ben/Marissa).
2) If you need a full export scoped to your account for SOC review, please confirm date range and fields and we can open a support ticket and provide the export under NDA.
3) Let us know whether data residency copies are required for this export (e.g., EU region).

Attaching a short spec that outlines the fields we'll include.

Thanks - Ben

---
Attachment: audit_logs_spec.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fincobank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence - next steps

Hi Ben - appreciate the quick recap. A couple clarifying items from our InfoSec team: 

- For the sample export, we need the following fields: timestamp (UTC), actor_id, actor_role, action_type, resource_id, resource_type, request_origin_ip (anonymize if necessary), and result (success/fail).
- Please confirm whether actor_id is user_id or an internal service account id; if both exist, include mapping notes.
- Retention policy: what is the default retention window for these logs, and is there an on-request export of historical data beyond retention?
- Export format: CSV is preferred. Can you include a header row and provide a short README describing field formats and any redaction rules?

If possible, send the sample redacted CSV and the README today so we can share with auditors. For a full export, we will confirm date range (likely Jan 1- May 31, 2026) and scope next.

Thanks - Aisha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T20:31:00Z
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence - next steps

Hi Aisha - thanks for the specifics. Attaching a redacted sample CSV and a short README that explains fields and redaction rules. Key notes up front: 

- actor_id: will be the customer-facing user_id when available; internal service accounts are labelled with svc_ prefixes. README includes mapping rules.
- IPs: we redact full IPs to preserve privacy and include first-two-octet masking in sample; we can provide full IPs under an appropriate request/NDA and with justification.
- Retention: default audit-log retention = 180 days. We retain higher-fidelity system logs (e.g., infra-level) for 365 days but those are on a separate retention policy and require a formal data request.
- Historical exports: yes, we can provide exports beyond default retention if requested; those are handled as a support escalation and require approval (we'll create a ticket and share estimated delivery time).

If Jan 1- May 31 is the requested window, please confirm and we'll start the ticket for a scoped export. Also confirm whether you need logs delivered to a secure S3 bucket or uploaded to your drive link.

Cheers - Marissa

---
Attachments: fincobank_audit_logs_20260601.csv (CSV, redacted sample, 120KB)
